campuses.title: Dubai Silicon Oasis Campus
campuses.text: Современный кампус в технологическом районе Dubai Silicon Oasis — College of Engineering, College of Computing and Information Sciences, Saunders College of Business, College of Art and Design, College of Liberal Arts. AED 500M расширение завершено в 2023.

paragraphs: Rochester Institute of Technology — Dubai (RIT Dubai) is a private American university and the third international satellite campus of Rochester Institute of Technology (Rochester, NY). Founded in 2008, RIT Dubai is based in Dubai Silicon Oasis and is one of only two universities in the UAE to offer a true American degree — graduates earn the same diploma issued by RIT's New York campus.

RIT Dubai is accredited by the UAE Commission for Academic Accreditation (CAA), ABET (engineering programs), the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (MSCHE), and Dubai's Knowledge and Human Development Authority (KHDA). Engineering programs — Electrical, Mechanical and Industrial — are ABET-accredited, the gold standard for engineering education worldwide.

The university hosts ~2,200 students across undergraduate and graduate levels, with 90+ nationalities represented and 130 academic staff. RIT Dubai's signature feature is mandatory cooperative education — every bachelor's student completes 700+ hours of work experience before graduation, contributing to an 80% post-graduation employment rate.

RIT Dubai's portfolio spans Engineering, Computing and Information Sciences (including Cybersecurity), Saunders College of Business, New Media Design, and Liberal Arts. Graduate programs include MS Engineering Management, MS Cybersecurity, MS Organizational Leadership and Innovation, and three MS Professional Studies tracks: Data Analytics, Future Foresight and Planning, Smart Cities. A 500M AED campus expansion was completed in 2023.
paragraphsRu: Rochester Institute of Technology — Dubai (RIT Dubai) — частный американский университет, третий международный satellite campus Rochester Institute of Technology (Рочестер, штат NY). Основан в 2008 году, расположен в Dubai Silicon Oasis. Один из двух университетов в UAE, выдающих true American degree — выпускники получают тот же диплом, что и в кампусе RIT в New York.

RIT Dubai аккредитован UAE Commission for Academic Accreditation (CAA), ABET (engineering программы), Middle States Commission on Higher Education (MSCHE) и Knowledge and Human Development Authority (KHDA). Engineering программы — Electrical, Mechanical и Industrial — имеют ABET-аккредитацию, золотой стандарт engineering-образования.

В университете учится ~2,200 студентов на бакалавриате и магистратуре, 90+ национальностей и 130 преподавателей. Ключевая особенность RIT Dubai — обязательное cooperative education: каждый бакалавр проходит 700+ часов work experience до выпуска, что даёт 80% employment rate после диплома.

Портфолио RIT Dubai охватывает Engineering, Computing and Information Sciences (включая Cybersecurity), Saunders College of Business, New Media Design и Liberal Arts. Магистратура: MS Engineering Management, MS Cybersecurity, MS Organizational Leadership and Innovation и три трека MS Professional Studies — Data Analytics, Future Foresight and Planning, Smart Cities. Расширение кампуса на AED 500M завершено в 2023.
